candidate_reusable_pattern.concept: A read-only admitted-cases query takes an explicitly resolved subject and case category in the selected effective MODEL, and returns its complete declared cases. Resolve same-bearer Role for Forms and the same Relation Definition active Subject for Relation notation.
requirements: Admission is established by governing declarations, never by observing a value in use. Resolve declared model overrides without inventing a universal whole-set union or replacement policy.
A known complete empty set differs from an unknown, cyclic, ambiguous or incomplete resolution, which is an error. Query results alone do not mutate instances or define a new graph Node.

Form candidates must resolve to typed, declared atomic Form units under the resolved Role; do not infer atomicity from a literal. An independently defined no-placeholder condition remains necessary unless non-placeholder is part of the governing admission criterion. A Form may have the same name as its Role.

Relation short-notation cases are bound to the resolved Relation, not automatically to the notation_for_subject Property admission set. A nonempty set requires that Property; do not add value-membership requirements.
